commands.cmd:

import re,sys
src=open(sys.argv[1]).read();b=src[src.index('ExpectedStatistics'):];b=b[:b.index('};')]
want=dict(re.findall(r'\{\"([^\"]+)\",\s*\"([^\"]*)\"\}',b));got={}
for line in open(sys.argv[2]):
    if line.startswith('STATISTICS:: '):
        body=line[13:].rstrip('\n');ks=[k for k in want if body.startswith(k+' ')]
        if ks: k=max(ks,key=len);got[k]=body[len(k)+1:]
bad={k:(want[k],got.get(k)) for k in want if got.get(k)!=want[k]}
print('upstream BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm ExpectedStatistics:',len(want),'| matched by this run:',len(want)-len(bad),'| Total Orders',got.get('Total Orders'),'End Equity',got.get('End Equity'),'OrderListHash',got.get('OrderListHash'),'| mismatches',bad)
raise SystemExit(0 if want and not bad else 1)
" "$L/Lean/Algorithm.CSharp/BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm.cs" "$W/run/stdout.txt" && python3 -c "
import collections,json,sys
e=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));c=dict(collections.Counter(x['status'] for x in e))
print('order events',len(e),c)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(e)==6 and c=={'submitted':3,'filled':3} else 1)

reviews.ref: Reproduce: re-ran cmd0 and cmd1 in full (offline bwrap sandbox, temp dirs): identical results, 28/28 ExpectedStatistics matched, 6 order events (3 submitted / 3 filled), empty-data control exits 1 with the empty-order-list hash. Adequacy-checked: (1) layer role backtesting-engine (LEAN as frozen comparator): the unmodified upstream BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm runs on bundled data and reproduces upstream's own expected statistics; (2) positive control: the same launcher on an empty data folder fails with a different result; (3) backed: source HEAD equals the winner pin and stack source_pin, tracked diff is exactly the documented dependency patch, all in retained output; (4) bound: component_id lean is the winner, tool_versions is the pin commit, pin_matches True. Residual (disclosed in limitations): the launcher is the existing on-host build and the receipt retains no build stamp tying the binary to HEAD; I saw the DLL is newer than the HEAD commit and the pinned source's own 28 statistics match, which I judge adequate.

Independent session (claude-opus-5-5); adequacy-checked points 2 and 3 against the receipt JSON and reproduced once in a throwaway cp -a copy of the worktree. Defect confirmed: command 2 fails open. The primary run's checks and the control run form one && chain, so when the primary run or its statistics check fails the control never runs, crc is nonzero, and '! grep -q' succeeds on the missing control/stdout.txt, so the command exits 0. Re-run with only the primary run's --data-folder pointed at a missing directory: exit 0, grep reported control/stdout.txt missing, and the command still printed its 'every ExpectedStatistics field matched' success sentence. This recording's excerpt does show 28/28 statistics and 6 order events, so the observed run succeeded, but its exit status cannot fail on a failed primary run and 'Every command exits 0 on its own assertions' overstates what exit 0 proves (point 3). Fail-closed successor: lean--use--20260926.
